result.title: How Agentic AI is Powering Autonomous Networks
result.description:
Network automation and autonomous networks aren't the same thing — and the gap between them is where the next generation of telco operations lives.

This video breaks down what it takes to get there: agentic AI, closed-loop operations, and an ecosystem building on NVIDIA platforms to make it real.

🔗 Learn more at https://nvda.ws/3TCovrz

result.title: Why AI Agents Need More Than One Model
result.description:
AI agents are built with many models, each bringing different strengths to the work. This explainer shows how powerful models can plan complex workflows while specialized models search enterprise data, call tools, review code, and validate results efficiently.

See how frontier and open models work together in production applications, intelligently matching each task to the right model to balance accuracy, efficiency, customization, and control.

result.title: Meet Alpamayo 2 Super
result.description:
Meet Alpamayo 2 Super, now commercially available for robotaxis and autonomous vehicles.

Built for complex real-world driving, this open reasoning model adds 360° awareness, high-level driving decisions and automated reasoning labels.

We built it, so you can build on it.

result.title: NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super: The Frontier Open Model for Robotaxis and Autonomous Vehicle
result.description:
NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super is here — the frontier open reasoning model for autonomous vehicles and robotaxis, now available for commercial use.

With 34B parameters and full 360° surround coverage, Alpamayo 2 Super handles trajectories, reasoning traces, meta-actions, and auto-labels in one model — streamlining what would've taken several models. 

It's open source under the OpenMDW-1.1 license — covering fine-tuning, derivative models, and commercial redistribution — giving AV developers a direct path from adaptation to deployment.

We built it, so you can build on it. 

📥 Download: https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Alpamayo2-Super
📝 Corp blog: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/alpamayo-2-super-open-model-now-available
➡️ Learn more: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/solutions/autonomous-vehicles/alpamayo/

result.title: Real-Time Neurological Insights: Scaling NeuroDX AI with NVIDIA Inception
result.description: Traditional health monitoring often relies on intermittent measurements, making early detection of neurological and physiological changes difficult. NeuroDX AI addresses this challenge by using AI to decode complex multimodal bio signals. Powered by NVIDIA H200 GPUs, TensorRT™, and NVIDIA Triton™ Inference Server, NeuroDX AI accelerates model training and optimizes inference for ultra-low latency and high throughput. Discover how NVIDIA's Inception program enabled NeuroDX AI with specialized training, early technology access, venture capital connections, and global showcase opportunities to turn complex bio signal data into actionable health intelligence.
